column1: # ============ Exclusive Procurement (banner Komandan baru) ============
=Exclusive Procurement is a special procurement event for new Commanders.
column2: Exclusive Procurement adalah event procurement khusus untuk Komandan baru.

column1: =For this banner, Commanders will enjoy a 20% discount when performing 10 accesses.
column2: Di banner ini, Komandan mendapat diskon 20% saat melakukan 10 access.

column1: =This banner will last until 50 accesses have been performed and will automatically close once those accesses have been performed.
column2: Banner ini berlangsung sampai 50 access dilakukan dan otomatis tutup begitu jumlah itu tercapai.

column1: =During this access, every 10 accesses will guarantee one of the following: a standard Doll, an Elite Doll or a standard weapon.
column2: Di access ini, tiap 10 access dijamin mendapat salah satu dari: Doll standar, Elite Doll, atau senjata standar.

column1: =In this access type, if an Elite Doll is not obtained within 49 consecutive accesses, the 50th access is guaranteed to yield an Elite Doll.
column2: Di tipe access ini, kalau Elite Doll tidak didapat dalam 49 access berturut-turut, access ke-50 dijamin memberi Elite Doll.

column1: =If an Elite Doll is obtained beforehand, an Elite Doll is not guaranteed on the 50th access.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll sudah didapat sebelumnya, access ke-50 tidak lagi menjamin Elite Doll.

column1: =In this access type, an Elite Doll must be selected from the list provided before accesses can be performed.
column2: Di tipe access ini, satu Elite Doll harus dipilih dari daftar yang tersedia sebelum access bisa dilakukan.

column1: =The selected Doll can be changed at any time and once a Doll is selected, the Elite Doll obtained will be the selected Doll.
column2: Doll yang dipilih bisa diganti kapan saja, dan begitu satu Doll dipilih, Elite Doll yang didapat adalah Doll itu.

column1: =The guarantee counter for this banner will always accumulate and is independent of other banners.
column2: Hitungan jaminan banner ini selalu terakumulasi dan terpisah dari banner lain.

column1: # ============ Targeted Procurement (Doll) ============
=Targeted Procurement is a limited-time Doll access event.
column2: Targeted Procurement adalah event access Doll waktu terbatas.

column1: =<color=#f26c1c>※During the event, the limited Elite Doll "{0}", limited Standard Weapon "{1}", and limited Retired Weapon "{2}" can only be obtained through the [{3}] event.
column2: <color=#f26c1c>※Selama event, Elite Doll terbatas "{0}", Standard Weapon terbatas "{1}", dan Retired Weapon terbatas "{2}" hanya bisa didapat lewat event [{3}].

column1: =After the event concludes, the Elite Doll "{4}" will not be added to Standard Procurement.</color>
column2: Setelah event berakhir, Elite Doll "{4}" tidak akan ditambahkan ke Standard Procurement.</color>

column1: =In this access type, the base probability of obtaining an Elite Doll is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, with an overall probability (including guarantees) of <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.
column2: Di tipe access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Elite Doll adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, dengan probabilitas keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan) <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.

column1: =In this access type, the base probability of obtaining a Standard Doll or Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, with the base probability for Standard Dolls being <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color> and for Standard Weapons being <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>.
column2: Di tipe access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Doll atau Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>, dengan probabilitas dasar Standard Doll <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color> dan Standard Weapon <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>.

column1: =The overall probability (including guarantees) for both is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan) untuk keduanya adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.

column1: =In this access type, every 10 accesses guarantee the acquisition of either a Standard Doll, Weapon, or an Elite Doll.
column2: Di tipe access ini, tiap 10 access dijamin mendapat Standard Doll, Weapon, atau Elite Doll.

column1: =If no Elite Doll is obtained after 58 consecutive accesses, the probability of acquiring one will increase with each subsequent access, with a guarantee of obtaining an Elite Doll by the 80th access.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll tidak didapat setelah 58 access berturut-turut, probabilitasnya naik tiap access berikutnya, dengan jaminan mendapat Elite Doll pada access ke-80.

column1: =Upon obtaining an Elite Doll, the counter resets, returning the probability to its base value.
column2: Begitu Elite Doll didapat, hitungannya direset dan probabilitasnya kembali ke nilai dasar.

column1: =If the acquired Elite Doll is not the current event's highlighted Doll, the next Elite Doll obtained is guaranteed to be the featured one.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll yang didapat bukan Doll unggulan event ini, Elite Doll berikutnya dipastikan yang unggulan.

column1: =The counter to a guaranteed item accumulates independently and does not affect other access types.
column2: Hitungan menuju item jaminan terakumulasi sendiri dan tidak memengaruhi tipe access lain.

column1: =During this access event, each time you obtain a Retired Weapon, you will receive 2 additional Withdrawal Receipts; acquiring a Standard Doll or Weapon grants 12 extra Redundant Pieces; obtaining an Elite Doll or Weapon awards 60 extra Redundant Pieces.
column2: Selama event access ini, tiap kali mendapat Retired Weapon, kamu menerima tambahan 2 Withdrawal Receipts; mendapat Standard Doll atau Weapon memberi tambahan 12 Redundant Pieces; mendapat Elite Doll atau Weapon memberi tambahan 60 Redundant Pieces.

column1: =Regardless of the method (including but not limited to access, conversion, events, etc.), duplicate Dolls are converted according to the following rules:
column2: Bagaimanapun caranya (termasuk tapi tidak terbatas pada access, konversi, event, dsb.), Doll ganda dikonversi menurut aturan berikut:

column1: =When obtaining a duplicate Standard Doll, the 2nd through 7th acquisitions convert into 30 Neural Archives for the respective Doll; from the 8th acquisition onward, they convert into 18 Redundant Pieces.
column2: Saat mendapat Standard Doll ganda, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Neural Archives untuk Doll terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 18 Redundant Pieces.

column1: =For duplicate Elite Dolls, the 2nd through 7th acquisitions convert into 30 Neural Archives for the respective Doll; from the 8th acquisition onward, they convert into 90 Redundant Pieces.
column2: Untuk Elite Doll ganda, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Neural Archives untuk Doll terkait; mulai perolehan ke-8, dikonversi jadi 90 Redundant Pieces.

column1: # ============ rincian rate-up & Retired Weapon ============

=When an Elite Weapon is obtained, the probability that it is the rate-up Elite Weapon is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL3]</color> and the probability that it is the non-rate up Elite Weapon is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL4]</color>.
column2: Saat Elite Weapon didapat, probabilitas bahwa itu Elite Weapon rate-up adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL3]</color> dan probabilitas bahwa itu Elite Weapon non-rate-up adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL4]</color>.

column2: Di tipe access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>, dengan probabilitas keseluruhan (termasuk jaminan) <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.

column1: =When a standard weapon is obtained, the probability that it is a rate-up standard weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL7]</color>.
column2: Saat senjata standar didapat, probabilitas bahwa itu senjata standar rate-up adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL7]</color>.

column1: =The probability that it is a non-rate up standard weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL8]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas bahwa itu senjata standar non-rate-up adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL8]</color>.

column1: =The base probability of obtaining a retired weapon is <color=#3191ab>[VAL9]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas dasar mendapat retired weapon adalah <color=#3191ab>[VAL9]</color>.

column1: =The combined probability of obtaining a retired weapon (including the guarantee) is <color=#3191ab>[VAL10]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas gabungan mendapat retired weapon (termasuk jaminan) adalah <color=#3191ab>[VAL10]</color>.

column1: =When obtaining a retired weapon, there is a <color=#3191ab>[VAL11]</color> probability that it is a rate-up retired weapon.
column2: Saat mendapat retired weapon, ada probabilitas <color=#3191ab>[VAL11]</color> bahwa itu retired weapon rate-up.

column1: =The probability of obtaining a non-rate up retired weapon is <color=#3191ab>[VAL12]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas mendapat retired weapon non-rate-up adalah <color=#3191ab>[VAL12]</color>.

column1: =The probabiility of obtaining a standard weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL13]</color> (with a total combined probability of [VAL14] after including the guarantee).
column2: Probabilitas mendapat senjata standar adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL13]</color> (dengan total probabilitas gabungan [VAL14] setelah menghitung jaminan).

column1: =The probabiility of obtaining an Elite Weapon is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL15]</color>(with a total combined probability of <color=#EDA51C>[VAL16]</color> after including the guarantee).
column2: Probabilitas mendapat Elite Weapon adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL15]</color>(dengan total probabilitas gabungan <color=#EDA51C>[VAL16]</color> setelah menghitung jaminan).

column1: =If no Elite Weapon is obtained after 50 consecutive accesses, the probability of obtaining one increases with each subsequent access, The probability increases by <color=#EDA51C>[VAL17]</color> for the next access and continues increasing by the same amount for every access thereafter, with a guarantee of receiving an Elite Weapon by the 70th access.
column2: Kalau Elite Weapon tidak didapat setelah 50 access berturut-turut, probabilitasnya naik tiap access berikutnya. Probabilitasnya naik <color=#EDA51C>[VAL17]</color> untuk access berikutnya dan terus naik dengan jumlah sama untuk tiap access setelahnya, dengan jaminan mendapat Elite Weapon pada access ke-70.
